texts.zh:
根据从[From.GetName]政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在个别[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]上显现。神经网络交流对他们而言不是新东西，这些报告称他们还产生了一种前所未见的超自然能力。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于少数[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
texts.en:
Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], according to leaked reports from authorities in the [From.GetName]. While neural-networked communication among their kind is nothing new, these reports describe paranormal abilities that are beyond anything in our existing records about them.

These powers are so far limited to a very small minority of [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The reports offer no explanation for the phenomenon.

texts.zh:
根据从[From.GetName]政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在[From.GetSpeciesName]机体上显现。这一定是最近才发生的进展，在此之前我们没有[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]展示过灵能力量的记录。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于少数[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
texts.en:
Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain individuals of [From.GetSpeciesName] mechanotype, according to leaked reports from authorities in the [From.GetName]. This must be a fairly recent development, since we have no record on file of [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] ever having displayed psionic abilities.

These powers are so far limited to a very small minority of [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The reports offer no explanation for the phenomenon.

texts.zh:
根据从[From.GetName]政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在个别[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]上显现。尽管在它们物种中意识连接并不是什么新东西，但这些报告称他们还产生了一种前所未见的超自然能力。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于[From.GetSpeciesName]物种中的很小一部分。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
texts.en:
Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], according to leaked reports from authorities in the [From.GetName]. While a cognitive connection among their species is nothing new, these reports describe paranormal abilities that are beyond anything in our existing records about them.

These powers are so far limited to a very small minority of the [From.GetSpeciesName] species as a whole. The reports offer no explanation for the phenomenon.

texts.en:
Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain individuals belonging to the [From.GetSpeciesName] species, according to leaked reports from authorities in the [From.GetName]. This must be a fairly recent development, since we have no record on file of [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] ever having displayed psionic abilities.

These powers are so far limited to a very small minority of the [From.GetSpeciesName] species as a whole. The reports offer no explanation for the phenomenon.

texts.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]的人口已开始展示类似的变化，在他们族群发生的变化不局限于一小片区域。
texts.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] population within our borders have begun exhibiting similar changes as well, so whatever is happening to their kind is not localized to any single region of space.

label.zh: 他们的巫术可救不了他们。
label.en: Their sorcery will not be enough to save them.

label.zh: 是的，我们已经编目了他们的灵能频率。
label.en: Yes... We have registered their psionic frequencies.
